messages.author: 0acf3f5daaab369b
messages.subject: FMR with MethylSeekeR compared with Methylkit Segments
parts:
Hello,

am reading the bioRxiv paper "Strategies for analyzing bisulfite sequencing data". In figure 4 (a,b,c)  they compare the segments methylation values obtained with Methylkit with UMR,LMR,FMR obtained with MethylSeekeR. How do they obtained the FMR with MethylSeekeR? As far as I know from the tutorial here it possible to obtain only UMR, FMR and PMD?

Any idea? I write in this group because member of this tool have posted in bioRxiv the manuscript.

Thanks in advance

messages.author: a413e6cf6c4ea2cc
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] Re: FMR with MethylSeekeR compared with Methylkit Segments
parts:
The gaps() function is part of the GenomicRanges package, it is explained in the  "Basic interval operations for GRanges objects" section of their vignette http://bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/vignettes/GenomicRanges/inst/doc/GenomicRangesIntroduction.pdf .

In general it returns the intermediate ranges between the defined ranges in a Granges object.

As you already pointed out, MethylSeekR only returns UMRs and LMRs, so we use this function to obtain the FMRs  ("gaps") between those regions (LMR and UMR).

Best,

Alex
